cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Welcome to the swimming club! You're very welcome to watch until your induction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lovely. Can I join today's induction?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Absolutely, once you've observed one. Today you can watch from the gallery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The gallery's closed. Could I watch from the poolside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love to have you there. Poolside access requires induction, though. Let's find you a brochure with a lovely view.
